name: Gujarat major rivers
description: Six selected main rivers: Narmada, Tapi, Mahi, Sabarmati, Banas and Damanganga. WRIS line geometry clipped to the Natural Earth Gujarat reference state polygon; no invented river coordinates. Main stems only as named in source, not a complete drainage network. WGS84 longitude/latitude.
